title: Route packing and bottlenecks
notes: For another visit, keep one best route collection and its matching closure certificate. K-1 can find every preserving closure (P4-5) or play the closure game (P6). Grades 2-3 can choose complete closures (P3), an added-arrow puzzle (P4), or rerouting (P5). Grades 4-5 can return to cuts and change-walks (P3-6), then use P7 as a separate general-proof investigation. The proof route remains available even if the first meeting ends with one physical certificate.
